data.current_description:
You need to use this endpoint if you have an API-only integration with Apple Pay which uses Adyen's Apple Pay certificate.

The endpoint returns the Apple Pay session data which you need to complete the [Apple Pay session validation](https://docs.adyen.com/payment-methods/apple-pay/api-only?tab=adyen-certificate-validation_1#complete-apple-pay-session-validation).

message: Operation 'post-cardDetails' has semantic quality issues: vague_summary, missing_context. The current summary is vague. The summary should indicate the action of retrieving card details. The description is mostly clear but could be more concise and focused on the primary purpose of the operation.

data.current_summary: Get the brands and other details of a card
data.current_description:
Use this endpoint to get information about the card or network token that enables you to decide on the routing of the transaction and the eligibility of the card for the type of transaction.

If you include [your supported brands](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/CheckoutService/latest/post/cardDetails__reqParam_supportedBrands) in the request, the response also tells you if you support each [brand that was identified on the card](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/CheckoutService/latest/post/cardDetails__resParam_details).

If you have an API-only integration and collect card data, use this endpoint to find out if the shopper's card is co-branded. For co-branded cards, you must let the shopper choose the brand to pay with if you support both brands.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve card details for transaction routing
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves information about the card or network token to determine transaction routing and card eligibility. If supported brands are included in the request, the response indicates which brands are supported. For co-branded cards, the shopper must choose the brand to pay with if both brands are supported.
data.reasoning: The current summary is vague. The summary should indicate the action of retrieving card details. The description is mostly clear but could be more concise and focused on the primary purpose of the operation.
